tidbit: Did you know… about 7,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic's internal artificial intelligence usage now exceeds what the company pays its employees. Reported by Business Insider: 90% plus of code is written by Claude.
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon scores 88.2% in security tests and targets elite security teams. Reported by BornCity: the model sets new benchmarks in artificial intelligence driven cybersecurity.
Cambio, an artificial intelligence native crypto exchange, brings swap quotes to ChatGPT. Reported by CryptoPotato: the service covers 100 plus coins across 25 networks.
Anthropic removes the five hour limit on Ultra and rebrands its plans. Reported by The Next Web: prices stay the same.
Alibaba and Apple integrate Qwen artificial intelligence into Apple Intelligence for China. Reported by The Express Tribune: the beta starts November 4.
Free every hour.
